title: [In mail-digest-2026-11-14...
content_text:
[In mail-digest-2026-11-14 there's a rating scheme — what actually decides whether something gets ingested?]
mail-digest-2026-11-14 入面有个等级分类，到底乜嘢内容先至会被 Ingest？
[Go over the ingest criteria and tell me if they hold up.]
你验收下呢套 Ingest 标准合唔合格，经唔经得起审。
[Even for article-type emails, you should judge whether they're actually worth ingesting first — hold them to the same bar as gtask ingestion.]
就算係文章型邮件，都要先判断下有冇价值先至 Ingest 入库，同 Ingest gtasks 睇齐。
